arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
import parse
import re

# Add digits field
fmt = '''
            letters: {:w}
            non-letters: {:W}
            whitespace: "{:s}"
            non-whitespace: \t{:S}\n
            digits: {:d} {:d}
        '''

data = '''
            letters: abcdef_GHIJLK
            non-letters: !@#%$ *^%
            whitespace: "   \t\n"
            non-whitespace: \tabc\n
            digits: 12345 0b1011011
        '''

p = parse.Parser(fmt)
print("Expression:", repr(p._expression))
print()

m = p._match_re.match(data)
print("Match result:", m)
if m:
    print("Groups:", m.groups())
else:
    # Try to find where it fails
    for i in range(min(200, len(data))):
        sub = data[:i+1]
        m2 = p._match_re.match(sub)
        if not m2:
            print(f"Failed at position {i}: char={repr(data[i])}, context={repr(data[max(0,i-15):i+20])}")
            break
EOF
